Bug_Details: When adding or subtracting from a Period, Duration is incompatible. Period.(plus|minus)(TemporalAmount) will always throw a DateTimeException when passed a Duration.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where it attempts to add a Duration to a Period, which is incompatible. This will throw a DateTimeException.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case 'testShowBug' calls the method'showBug' of the 'PeriodTimeMathBug' class with a Period and a Duration as arguments. However, the'showBug' method attempts to add a Duration to a Period, which is incompatible and will throw a DateTimeException. Since the test case does not catch this exception, the test will fail, triggering the bug.
